item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 29/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Mawar is expected to move across the seas east of Luzon today, and turn northwards gradually in the Luzon Strait in the following couple of days. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement. Under the influence of the outer subsiding air of Mawar, it will be persistently very hot and mainly fine over the coast of southern China in the next few days. Showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Besides, there will be swells over the coastal waters.
